organization.name: Formbricks GmbH
organization.notes: 2022 dates snoopForms/Formbricks project work and rebrand, not a verified GmbH incorporation date. German private limited company. OSS Capital equity backing is explicit; individuals described as supporters are not automatically classified as equity investors.

pricingTiers.name: Community Edition
pricingTiers.notes: Software license cost is zero; infrastructure, extensions and external services can cost extra.

pricingTiers.name: Pro
pricingTiers.notes: Pro explicitly Most popular and displays $74/Month. Static view did not establish selected monthly-versus-annual billing state; numeric subscription fields withheld rather than assigning the wrong term. Scope is commercial Cloud.

pricingTiers.name: Scale
pricingTiers.notes: Closest organizational tier with Teams & access roles and workflows; displays $325/Month. Billing-toggle state not established in static extract, so monthly/annual amount remains unresolved. Scope commercial Cloud.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise Edition
pricingTiers.notes: Core free; advanced features require EE license. Contact licensing team for commercial terms; no verified public amount.

moats.claim: Survey targeting and an extensible experience-management workflow can create integration switching costs; proprietary EE gates qualify the open-core differentiation.

productReasons.claim: Link, website and in-app surveys let teams collect feedback in the user journey rather than only by a standalone form.
Conditional logic, recalled information and hidden fields support context-aware survey paths.
Partial responses and file uploads capture unfinished or richer feedback within survey results.

sponsorship.notes: Official April 2023 announcement explicitly states GitHub sponsorship through the inaugural Accelerator. This is verified historical program sponsorship; continuing 2026 financial support was not established.

requirements.condition: Docker single-host route OR Kubernetes Helm route

requirements.component: Formbricks app, Hub API and Hub worker
requirements.notes: v6 multi-service baseline, not a single app container.
Semantic layer API with PostgreSQL and memory queue driver in compose.
Bundled for all new installs, no EE license check; uses PostgreSQL datastore.
Public domain and open ports 80/443 for certificate issuance.

requirements.component: AI taxonomy service and model provider
requirements.notes: OpenAI-compatible, Vertex or Bedrock credentials; separate provider costs.

requirements.condition: Recommended managed service in production Kubernetes deployment

resources.memory: 4 GB floor evaluation; 8 GB low load
resources.storage: 20 GB SSD evaluation; 50 GB SSD low load
resources.os: Ubuntu for shell installer; Docker-compatible host or Kubernetes otherwise
resources.notes: Published single-server sizing derived from chart defaults, not load-tested. Kubernetes recommendation starts 3 nodes of 4 vCPU/8 GB with managed database/cache/object storage.

selfHosting.notes: Version 6 baseline has app, Hub API/worker, Cube, PostgreSQL, Redis/Valkey and SpiceDB stack. Do not reuse old PostgreSQL-only v3 requirements.

options.name: Formbricks Ubuntu shell installer
options.notes: Documentation calls it One-Click Setup but it is a command-line shell installer, with SSH, domain and ports configured first.

oneClickInstall.notes: Verified shell installer; classified one-command, not a graphical one-click marketplace.
